verdict.rationale: Genie lets users ask natural-language questions and get answers grounded in their organization's data, returning SQL, result tables and visualizations, including on mobile via Genie One. AI/BI dashboards add AI-assisted authoring, and Genie Code gives inline suggestions while working with Unity Catalog data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and evidence of proactive AI-generated data insights (the documented automatic recommendations cover query performance rather than the data itself).
